title: ASO Keyword Rank Tracker
description: Keyword ranks of apps on Google Play and the App Store, with changes, suggestions and competition.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to check, for example invoice maker or meditation app. Each keyword is checked in every store and country.

trackApps.title: Your apps to track
trackApps.description: Apps whose rank you want for every keyword, even outside the top results: Google Play package names or links (com.zoho.invoice) and App Store links or numeric ids (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/…/id694831622). Add competitors too.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Google Play checks the top 30 results, the App Store up to 200.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter store countries, for example US, GB, DE. US when empty.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of Google Play results, for example en or de.

topN.title: Top results per keyword
topN.description: How many of the top-ranked apps to save for each keyword (your tracked apps are always saved). 0 saves only your tracked apps.

includeSuggestions.title: Search suggestions
includeSuggestions.description: Add the store's search box suggestions for each keyword: the phrases people type, for finding new keywords.

historyName.title: History name
historyName.description: Ranks are remembered in a key-value store of this name in your account, so each run shows the change since the previous one. Use another name for a separate project.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The Actor connects directly, which is fastest. If Google Play starts limiting requests, it switches to Apify Proxy automatically. Turn on a proxy here only to use it from the start.
